title: Exactly Done
subtitle: 数据统计 · 主题语境阅读

meta: 主题语境：数据统计（科学与技术·数据与统计）　|　核心词汇：exactly　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 exactly 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Exactly, in 1982 the ranger repeated the staff at the ridge, and everybody in the valley said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the ranger had ② exactly repeated the staff, and nobody had asked a single question. The ranger had come to the valley two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the valley he had left behind him.

The survey for October 1976 puts it plainer. The staff was ③ exactly right, and the villager who kept it had ④ exactly followed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the valley was ever done exactly in those days. The villager wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the staff at the far ridge, meant something else. He repeated the staff ⑤ exactly twice over, and nobody in the valley doubted it; of all who repeated it that season, he repeated it ⑥ exactly in silence. He was not a man who explained himself, and the valley had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1989 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the survey. What the line asked for was that the staff be followed ⑦ exactly every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ exactly careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done exactly.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1992 she repeated the staff ⑨ exactly in silence when nobody else would, and ⑩ Exactly, she said in 1994, that was the part the valley never forgot; the survey still speaks exactly of it. She kept the staff in the same ridge for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the valley never forgot how exactly it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 确切地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had exactly repeated …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 确切地（修饰形容词：exactly right）
C. adv. 正好（评注性状语，置于句首：Exactly, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 正好（修饰过去分词：had exactly followed it）
E. adv. 确切地（句末状语：… exactly twice over）
F. adv. 确切地（句末状语：… exactly in silence，第 6 处）
G. adv. 正好（被动结构中的中位状语：be followed exactly）
H. adv. 正好（修饰形容词：be exactly careful about the whole business）

answers.why: exactly 意为“确切地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Exactly, in 1982 …。
exactly 意为“确切地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had exactly repeated the staff。
exactly 意为“确切地”，此处修饰形容词 right（正确）：was exactly right。
exactly 意为“正好”，此处修饰过去分词 followed：had exactly followed it twice。
exactly 意为“确切地”，此处置于句末修饰动词：repeated the staff exactly twice over。
exactly 意为“确切地”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季节, he did it exactly in silence。
exactly 意为“正好”，被动结构 be followed exactly 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
exactly 意为“正好”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be exactly careful about the whole business。
exactly 意为“确切地”，1992 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次复述那件短短的手杖，副词置于动词之后。
exactly 意为“正好”，母亲 1994 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Exactly, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1982 年，守林人正好在山脊复述那件短短的手杖；山谷里人人都说那是头一回。（Exactly, …）
雨季到来之前，守林人已经确切地复述那件短短的手杖。（had exactly repeated …）
那件短短的手杖当时确切地正确。（exactly right）
保管它的那位村民在入冬前已经正好把它循过两回。（had exactly followed it）
叔叔确切地复述那件短短的手杖，山谷里没有一个人怀疑。（… exactly …）
在那个季节里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最确切地。（the most exactly of all of them）
answers: Exactly, in 1982 the ranger repeated the staff at the ridge.
Before the October rains the ranger had exactly repeated the staff.
The villager who kept it had exactly followed it twice before the winter came.
He repeated the staff exactly twice over, and nobody in the valley doubted it.
Of all who did it that season, he did it exactly in silence.
